model: IPS 4000 pumping system controller - variable primary
applies_to: Armstrong IPS 4000 controllers set up for variable primary pumping: up to 8 pumps, 16 control zones and 8 chillers or boilers with flow and differential pressure limits.
summary: The IPS 4000 runs a group of variable-speed pumps. In the variable primary version its BACnet list adds chiller/boiler enables, minimum and maximum flow and differential pressure limits per chiller or boiler, and the related alarms, on top of pump modes, hand speeds, zone setpoints and values, pump speed, power, energy, head and flow, run hours and alarms.
notes: 121 rows printed as Reserved are left out.
Analog descriptions give the scaled range from the Represent column; the PDF also prints a raw integer range.

This list is for communication interface ver 2.1.0. Older IPS 4000 controllers (interface ver 1.0.0, Data Points 90.975, and the legacy 90.971) have their own data-point sheets; check which one matches the controller.
The PDF table is on pages 15-25.

integration.summary: Start and stop the IPS 4000 with BV 1 Remote Start, write the zone setpoints (AV 1-16) and read BI 110 IPS On Status, the active zone value, system flow and head, and BI 1 General Alarm. Reset alarms with BV 32. The BMS can also put each pump in Hand, Off or Auto (BV 2-25), set hand speeds, enable chillers/boilers and write zone values (bas Zone pv AVs).

minimum_points.name: Active Zone pv
minimum_points.why: Value of the zone in control

integration.enable: BV 1 Remote Start (0 = Stop, 1 = Start). The Set Pump Hand/Off/Auto BVs are momentary commands that change one pump's mode.
integration.remote_sensors: The bas Zone 1-16 pv AVs (48-63) are writable, so the BMS can supply zone values, and the bas Chiller/Boiler dp pv AVs (78-85) do the same for chiller/boiler differential pressure. The data-points sheet does not say how the controller chooses between BMS and wired values.
setup: The sheet lists BACnet TCP/IP and BACnet MS/TP. For BACnet IP use UDP port 47808 (0xBAC0).
The device instance and MS/TP settings are not given in the sheet.
gotchas: Set Pump Hand/Off/Auto BVs are momentary: write 1 to change the mode, and read the pump mode BIs to confirm it.
Design flow/head, BEP and dead-band AVs are commissioning settings; don't write them cyclically.
Units for pressure, temperature and flow follow the controller's unit setting.
